references.text: Direct continuation of the same dialogue where the offer of settlement is revealed as a manipulative strategy to mix the peoples.
Reveals the underlying greedy motives behind the same offer of settlement given in the source verse.
Clear thematic parallel between Abimelech and Shechem's invitations offering settlement to the patriarchs under conflict-ridden circumstances.
Direct continuation linking the offer of settlement to the strategy of marriage and unification of peoples.
